content:
yuna: Heads-up: saw a subtle detok / spacing regression after the int4 packaging for aurora-lite. Only triggers on sequences with fullwidth punctuation + ZWJ (U+200D) + bidi characters. chrF dropped ~1.6 on zh->en devset. Minimal repro below.

omar: can you paste a tiny failing sample?

yuna: sure. note the odd glue between punctuation and preceding han when ZWJ is present.

```
input: "示例：測試
〈測試
〉\u200D。"  # (fullwidth angle brackets + ZWJ + fullwidth period)
float decode: "示例：測試〈測試〉。"
int4 decode:  "示例：測試〈測試\u200D 。"  # space before fullwidth period and ZWJ token kept separate
```

mei: i.e. the tokenizer/runtime is emitting a separate token for the ZWJ and an extra space gets inserted during detok. That will mess with our token-aligned QA and exact-match asserts.

pavel: quick hypothesis: quant packaging moves some punctuation codepoints into their own token ids due to low-frequency reassignments in the truncated vocab. The packaging remaps indices based on frequency buckets which can split combined punctuation tokens.

yuna: I inspected the tok_map for aurora-lite-int4: the pair "\u3008\u3009" (fullwidth angle brackets) was originally a single multi-codepoint token id in float. After int4 rebuild it became two tokens with an extra ZWJ token inserted between in some cases.

omar: do we have a serializer/detok postprocess that inserts spaces when it sees standalone control-like tokens? maybe ZWJ is being treated like a separator.

mei: yes, detok has a heuristic: if codepoint is in category Cc/Cf we sometimes inject a neutral joiner spacing to avoid glue. That heuristic didn't expect ZWJ (Cf) to show up as its own token because float packaged it inside merged tokens. Now with ZWJ separate, detok runs the spacing rule.

qa-bot: regression alert: aurora-lite-int4 nightly vs float: chrF zh->en: float 56.8 -> int4 55.1 (-1.7). Exact punctuation matches dropped from 95.4% to 89.0%.

pavel: thanks. root cause looks like packaging remap + detok spacing heuristic. Fix options: (1) change packaging to preserve combined multi-codepoint punctuation tokens where present in float vocab, (2) change detok to treat ZWJ as invisible when adjacent to punctuation in our locale-specific rules, (3) add a packaging-time guard that compares detok outputs for a tiny punctuation-focused testset.

omar: (3) seems low-risk and would have caught this earlier. For immediate mitigation we could push a small detok tweak that disables spacing insertion for ZWJ-only tokens. That would be a fast canary.

yuna: agreed. i'll prototype a detok patch that skips spacing for Cf codepoints when they appear between paired punctuation or inside angle brackets. Will run local smoke.

pavel: in parallel i'll attempt a repack that preserves the original float token indices for punctuation-heavy entries. Might be a bit fiddly but doable in ~40m.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: aurora-lite-int4 -> canary-eu at 2026-03-21T19:05:00Z (rollout id r-2026-03-21-461).

mei: small note: some downstream apps rely on ZWJ presence (emoji ligature tasks). If we blind-filter ZWJ in detok we might break those. So prefer packaging fix if possible.

yuna: good point. we'll run A/B: Canary A = int4 current, Canary B = int4 + detok tweak (no packaging change). Evaluate punctuation exact-match + emoji ligature recall.

qa-bot: canary A/B job queued (job id j-7792). Expected 30m.

pavel: repack done locally. quick synthetic smoke: detok matches float on the punctuation set. Uploading artifact to s3://redwood-staging/models/aurora-lite-int4-repack-20260321.tar.gz

omar: excellent. once canary results are in we can decide whether to adopt detok tweak as a short-term patch and repack for long-term. Also add a packaging guard to our model-onboard checklist: "verify punctuation + bidi + ZWJ detok parity".

yuna: test results: Canary A chrF=55.0, punct-exact=88.9; Canary B chrF=55.2, punct-exact=90.1; Repacked int4 chrF=56.7, punct-exact=95.3 (almost parity).

mei: repack wins. packaging guard + repack for release. I'll draft a tiny postmortem and update onboarding checklist.

yuna: filing ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/ML-8701 (includes repro, maps, repack artifact). cc @pavel @mei

pavel: I'll make the packaging script preserve combined tokens and add a unit test that diffs detok outputs for a 50-sample punctuation suite.

yuna: thanks all. closing once release is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
